picks.quote: I just take the Giants because it feels I like Harbaugh number one and it just feels like they want to win
picks.reason: The Giants are at home and have a stronger desire to win.
picks.edge: The Giants have a clearer motivation to win compared to the Commanders, who are just trying to save their coach's job.

rejected.quote: I took a shot on the commanders plus two and a half. I made the commanders a small favorite.
rejected.edge: I think in my previous visits here, I'm no fan of this Giants team and you know the commanders... I just don't see how the Giants are favorite in this game.
rejected.reason: Ed believes the Commanders have a better chance to win than the odds suggest.
